neighbours.label: The separately tokenized word piece 'sam' or Cyrillic 'сам', in names and ordinary words.
fire: Our new colleague Sam brought a sketchbook to the workshop.
A curator displayed a nineteenth-century map of Samarkand beside the entrance.
During the festival, visitors heard a story about Samson and the city gates.
A travel writer described the old harbor on Samos in her notebook.
The museum displayed photographs of Samarra taken before the restoration.
Вечером мальчик сам собрал небольшую модель корабля.
На собрании она сама предложила новый порядок работы.
The passenger asked whether the next train would stop in Samara.

notes: The card spans Latin, Cyrillic and Arabic spellings. This test covers Latin and Cyrillic pieces; it does not claim that every word containing the letters sam fires. Probes on sample and Samsung were quiet, consistent with different tokenization.
